name: National Scholarship for Post Graduate Studies
notes:
Objective: The objective of ‘National scholarship for PG studies’ is to provide financial assistance to Indian students leading to award of Postgraduate Degree.
Eligibility: Students who are admitted in the first year of PG degree programme through ‘Regular/Full Time’ mode in an eligible university/ college/institution are eligible to apply. In case of integrated programmes, the scholarship shall be given for PG component only. The age limit is 30 years. The scholarship is available only for students who are pursuing recognized PG degree programmes leading to specified PG degrees notified by UGC from time to time i.e. the nomenclature and duration of course should be as per UGC Notification on Specification of Degrees, 2014, as amended from time to time.
Slots: 10,000 per annum
Tenure: 2 years
